NOAA found the consolidated application in full compliance; certification, Federal Register notice and draft EIS come next, with a permit guided by end Q1-2027. Real and dated, but the stock already re-rated hard on the milestones (mid/late arc).

GEO lenders standstill to Jan 18 2027 on ~$1.7B Dec maturities (creditor litigation, lender rescue offers); dated restructuring milestone but equity outcome two-sided and stock already ran; Lightspeed service slipped to mid-2028.

Complicated merger arb: Blackstone pays $61.25 cash, but the NMPRC voided the $400M stock sale and fined the parties. The schedule is being reset after the Oct-16 examiner orders, the outside date is now May 2027 and close is guided H1-27; the regulatory-risk spread needs a check.

verified.catalyst: China SAMR clearance, probably with a behavioural remedy on copper-concentrate supply, is the last approval needed for the Anglo American-Teck all-share merger at 1.3301 Anglo shares per Teck share.
verified.dated_milestone: Both companies target closing by end of March 2027 (window Sep-2026 to Mar-2027). As of the Oct-2026 reports, the SAMR review clock was suspended in Phase III remedy negotiations. Next date: SAMR decision, not yet dated, at the latest before the Mar-2027 long-stop target.
verified.instrument: TECK common (NYSE). A spread trade would mean long TECK and short 1.3301 Anglo shares (2.66 NGLOY ADRs), adjusted for the roughly $4.19/sh special dividend that goes only to Anglo holders before completion.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes: named counterparty (Anglo American) and a named regulator (SAMR). G2 yes: signed plan of arrangement at a fixed 1.3301 ratio, with shareholder and Canada approvals done. G3 fails: no currently-unpriced figure. Ex-special-dividend, the implied value is about $51.4 against TECK at $51.58, so the spread is about 0%.
verified.edge: L. Implied deal value: NGLOY $21.42 x 2 = about $42.84 per Anglo ordinary share, minus the $4.19 special dividend = $38.65, x 1.3301 = about $51.41. TECK closes at $51.58 (FMP 2026-11-20), so the spread is about -0.3%, flat to slightly negative. Run-up from the pre-announcement base (TECK about $34-35 on 2025-09-08, approximate): about +48%, mostly copper beta. Remaining capture to the favorable-resolution value: about 0%. The event is fully harvested.
verified.primary_source: Anglo American press release 2025-09-09 (angloamerican.com/media/press-releases/2025/09-09-2025): 1.3301 ratio and a $4.5B (~$4.19/sh) special dividend. Reuters via Kitco/BNN 2026-10-02: SAMR demands copper-concentrate supply commitments, China is the only remaining approval, close by Mar-2027. FMP batch-quote 2026-11-20: TECK $51.58, NGLOY $21.42, AAL.L 3234p.
verified.analysis: The deal is real and contractual. SAMR is the only open approval and is negotiating a behavioural copper-supply remedy (Reuters/Bloomberg 2026-10-02; ION says a divestment is possible, which conflicts with Reuters), with close targeted by Mar-2027. Because the exchange ratio is fixed and Anglo pays a pre-close special dividend of about $4.19/sh to its own holders only, TECK trades at or slightly above the ex-dividend implied value. There is no arb spread to capture, and an outright long TECK is just a copper/Anglo equity beta bet (both down about 18% vs their 50-day averages). SAMR-delay or remedy risk sits on top of a 0% spread, so the payoff is asymmetric to the downside. This fails G3 and the residual-capture rule. Data gaps: no reporting from November 2026 was found, the pre-announcement TECK price is approximate, and the GBP/ADR conversion was taken from the NGLOY ADR (2 ADRs = 1 ordinary share) rather than a live FX rate.

A draft EIS and the final permit decision follow, and management now guides to having the permit about a year from now rather than by end of Q1 2027.

Next: certification decision by mid-Dec 2026 (moved from October after more than 1,600 comments), then the draft EIS, then the permit around Q4-2027, ahead of Q4-2027 offshore commissioning.
verified.instrument: TMC common (NASDAQ), $1.66 at the 2026-11-19 close, market cap about $733M. The stock is near its 52-week low of $1.60; the 52-week high is $10.05.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 passes (NOAA is the named counterparty) and so does dated sequencing (certification due mid-Dec 2026). G2 is partial: this is a regulatory process step, not a commitment to grant the permit. G3 fails: there is no specific contractual or unpriced dollar figure, and the upside depends on a pre-revenue nodule project that cannot be valued from today's capital structure.
verified.edge: L. The triage premise ("already re-rated hard") is stale and backwards. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is negative. The stock closed $5.06 on 2026-04-28 (full-compliance determination) and is $1.66 now, -67%. From the 2026-01-02 base of $6.78 it is -76%. So nothing is harvested, and the market is fading the milestones. Remaining % to a favorable-resolution value cannot be derived. There is no contractual number, and value depends on a permit now about 12 months out plus production at scale. Cash use is about $19.4M a quarter against roughly $123M of liquidity (cash plus credit lines; one outlet reports $79M cash, unconfirmed), so dilution before any permit is likely. A certification bounce of perhaps +30-60% from depressed levels is plausible but speculative and unquantified.
verified.primary_source: TMC Q3-2026 corporate update and earnings call (2026-11-12, via investingnews.com and the nasdaq.com transcript): certification decision by mid-Dec 2026, permit about a year out, about $123M liquidity. NOAA news release "NOAA advances review of first-ever deep seabed mining commercial recovery application" (noaa.gov; comment period closed 2026-10-19). TMC PR "NOAA Determines TMC USA's Consolidated Deep-Seabed Mining Application is in Full Compliance" (2026-05-01). FMP quote and EOD history, 2026-11-19 ($1.66; $5.06 on 2026-04-28).
verified.analysis: The regulatory path is real and dated: NOAA found the application fully compliant, and the certification decision is now due mid-Dec 2026. But the timeline has slipped twice (certification from October to mid-December; permit from Q1-2027 to about this time next year). The shares have fallen about 67% since the compliance milestone, so the market is pricing permitting delay, litigation and international-law risk, and financing risk, not harvesting a re-rating. Under the numerator-provenance rule the upside is derived, not contractual. I could not re-derive equity value: the 10-Q waterfall, the dilution runway and any preferred or warrant overhang were not checked within the lookup budget. That leaves the event scorable as real but the equity unscorable, so score is capped at 4. Watch the mid-Dec certification as a sentiment trigger only, not an ACTIVE position.

verified.catalyst: Telesat GEO's ad hoc lender committee (term loan, secured and unsecured holders) agreed on 2026-11-16 to a standstill through 2027-01-18 on the GEO term loan and secured notes due 2026-12-06 (~US$1.7-2.4B, figures differ by source). The lenders' rescue proposal (~$3.2B: $1.7B new equity plus $1.5B new debt) prices a shareholder rights offer at C$31.50, roughly half the stock price when it was offered.
verified.dated_milestone: 2027-01-18 standstill expiry (deadline for a GEO refinancing or restructuring deal). Further GEO maturities follow in Jun-2027 and Oct-2027. The Lightspeed fraudulent-conveyance suit (filed Jan-2026) is unresolved.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes (named counterparty: the GEO ad hoc lender committee). G2 partial (the standstill is signed and interest keeps being paid; no definitive refinancing deal). G3 fails for the equity: the only concrete figure, the C$31.50 rights price, sits below the current price, so it is a dilution marker, not upside.
verified.edge: L. Run-up: about +80% from the 52-week low of $23.01 to $41.31, though the stock is down 9% today and below its 50-day average of $45.27. Remaining: not derivable and plausibly negative. The lender plan raises $1.7B of equity at C$31.50 (about US$22.5) against a market cap of roughly $0.6B (FMP), which means heavy dilution of current holders. A default or contested restructuring, with litigation over Lightspeed priority, ranks the common behind about $2.4B+ of GEO debt. The event is dated and real, but the equity waterfall does not support upside at today's price.
verified.primary_source: Telesat press release 2026-11-16, 'Telesat enters into standstill arrangement with GEO lenders' (finviz). SatNews 2026-11-18 (standstill through 2027-01-18). SpaceQ / FT-sourced reports, late Oct to early Nov 2026, on the $3.2B lender rescue with the C$31.50 rights offer. FMP quote 2026-11-20 ($41.31).
verified.analysis: The standstill and the 2027-01-18 deadline are verified: the 2026-11-16 announcement and SatNews 2026-11-18. The milestone is forward and not yet fired. Every disclosed resolution path dilutes the equity or subordinates it: the lender rescue issues new equity at about half the market price and demands first claim on Telesat's Lightspeed stake. So the event is real, but the common does not capture its upside, and the score is capped by the equity, not the event (cap 4, scored 3). Gaps: I did not pull the latest 10-Q for the exact GEO debt stack or the share count, and the 'Lightspeed slipped to mid-2028' claim was not confirmed in the sources checked.

verified.catalyst: NMPRC approval of Blackstone's (Troy ParentCo) $61.25/sh cash takeover of TXNM/PNM. The case resumed after the Oct-16-2026 examiner orders allowed a refiled application with richer concessions (about $220M in rate credits plus other commitments).
verified.dated_milestone: NMPRC evidentiary hearing set for 2027-01-19 through 2027-02-01 (second revised procedural order). Then a recommended decision, a commission vote and close, guided H1-2027. The merger agreement's outside date is extended to May 2027.
verified.instrument: TXNM common (NYSE), long spread vs $61.25 cash
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (Blackstone named as buyer) + G2 (signed $61.25 cash merger agreement, extended outside date, refiled commitments). G3 fails: the remaining spread is a fully visible, market-priced figure, not an unpriced one.
verified.edge: L. Run-up: from a pre-announcement base of about $54-55 (May 2025, estimated, not looked up) to $58.96 today is about +7-9%, so most of the deal premium is already harvested. Remaining: $61.25/$58.96 = +3.9% gross, about +5.2% with roughly 2 more quarterly dividends (about $0.41 each, assumed to continue), over 5-7 months if close is H1-27. The downside if the deal breaks is to about $50 standalone utility value (estimated), about -15%. Implied market approval probability is about 75%. This NMPRC rejected the Avangrid-PNM deal in 2021 and found the Blackstone stock sale illegal in a 2-1 ruling, so 75% is not obviously too low. No informational edge.
verified.primary_source: NM PRC PNM Acquisition Case Information page (second revised procedural order, hearing 2027-01-19 to 02-01), prc.nm.gov, accessed 2026-11-20; Source NM 2026-10-19 (Oct-16 examiner orders, refiled terms); ABQ Journal (outside date extended to May 2027, H1-27 close guidance); FMP quote 2026-11-20 TXNM $58.96
verified.analysis: The deal is real and contractual: $61.25 cash, Blackstone, and the outside date extended to May 2027. The Oct-16-2026 examiner orders put it back on track: they declined to probe the Zimmer stock sale and allowed a refiled application with about $300M of concessions. The PRC page now schedules the evidentiary hearing for Jan 19 to Feb 1, 2027. Even so, the remaining capture is only about 4-5% against about 15% break downside, in front of a commission that has rejected a PNM takeover before and has already fined these parties. This is a fairly priced regulatory binary, not a mispriced one, so the score is capped at 4 as mostly harvested. Gaps: the pre-deal base price and break value are estimates, not looked up; the exact date of the second revised order is unconfirmed; dividend continuation is assumed.
